text: Pursuant to section 173(2) of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 and the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 3, the Ombudsman is required to submit an annual report on the activities of her office directly to City Council.
City Council on June 29 and 30, 2020 deferred consideration of Item CC22.6 to the July 28 and 29, 2020 meeting of City Council.
